prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1132; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any agent of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you provide the policy limits for all applicable coverages under the policy issued to your insured, including liability limits and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim file notes, repair and salvage records, and any communications with the insured or other parties. Destruction, alteration, or loss of such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
